en.headline: Buyers snap up nearly 300 new flats ahead of expected rate rises
en.dek: Developers sold out all units launched over the weekend as home-seekers moved to lock in mortgages before local rates climb, agents said.
body: Hong Kong developers sold all of the more than 290 new flats they launched over the weekend, as buyers sought to secure properties ahead of anticipated interest-rate increases later this year, according to property agents.

Major banks held rates steady despite the recent US Federal Reserve increase, giving buyers a window that many expect will close in the coming months, said Derek Chan Hoi-chiu, head of research at Ricacorp Properties.
Chan said a notable number of home-seekers were actively entering the market to lock in mortgages before local rates rise.

zh.headline: 買家趕在加息前入市 周末近300個新盤單位售罄
zh.dek: 發展商周末推售超過290個單位全部售出，代理指買家希望在本地息口上升前鎖定按揭。
body: 香港發展商周末推售的超過290個新盤單位已全部售出，物業代理表示，買家希望在預期本地息口稍後上升前入市鎖定按揭。
利嘉閣研究部主管陳海潮指，本地主要銀行在美國聯儲局近日加息後仍維持息口不變，令買家有一段窗口期，而不少人預期本地息口將於未來數月上升。
陳海潮表示，有相當數量的置業人士正積極入市，爭取在息口上升前鎖定物業。
